name: Bulwark imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, bigger and stockier than other imps, carrying a heavy slab of cooled black slag in front of it like a shield with both arms, peeking over the top

poses.stand: hovering low, holding the heavy black slag slab up in front of it like a shield, peeking over the top
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: paces forward with the slab held in front, wings straining under the weight, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
